behaviors.behavior: One coverage row per weakness class, closed status vocabulary
Status precedence degraded > not_requested > not_available > covered
A backend capability outside the OSS tool map still gets a row
Prompt-injection row added only when it carries information
An empty or absent manifest is never 'complete'
findings.json carries coverage; the --input-from-cache re-read keeps it
Report renders the coverage banner and table, PR mode included
'Coverage not reported' stays distinct from 'Incomplete Coverage'
Sidecar gains coverage while schema_version stays 1
--input coverage is authoritative; a pre-feature input never inherits the local config's manifest
The prompt-injection row reads `covered` only when the prompt-risks file exists AND parses
Every coverage table cell is escaped — the manifest is read back from an untrusted file
A non-dict findings artifact degrades to [] instead of crashing the report
behaviors.evidence: test_coverage_false_claims.py::test_wrong_shape_prompt_risks_file_is_not_covered PASSED (pre-existing AttributeError in load_findings_from_file, surfaced here)

behaviors.behavior: A file-sourced manifest is sanitized at the boundary (non-dict rows dropped, control chars flattened, values capped)
Every sanitized status is inside the closed vocabulary; an unrecognized one coerces to degraded with the original in detail
coverage_sanitize's duplicated vocabulary cannot drift from scan_coverage.COVERAGE_STATUSES
class_label is the single chokepoint and flattens an unknown, possibly-hostile class id
A hostile manifest cannot add an instruction line to the report banner
with_prompt_injection_row tolerates non-dict rows instead of raising
degraded is derived from what happened to the leg, not the exit code alone
Pre-feature artifacts (no coverage key) are tolerated by every named reader
A caller-overridden class_tools map also attributes degraded legs
behaviors.evidence: scan_coverage._degraded_by_class inverts the effective map; test_scan_coverage.py::test_degraded_leg_beats_every_other_status PASSED

behaviors.behavior: No baselined file exceeds its recorded bloat `current`
behaviors.evidence: anti_ratchet_check.py --worktree exits 0; the four shrunk files' baselines re-synced to their measured sizes, guarded against the ORIGINAL values

behaviors.behavior: No test writes .shipwright/ into the plugin source tree; a test that does fails loudly instead of leaving an untracked file
behaviors.evidence: conftest.py::_no_source_tree_pollution (autouse). Verified by a throwaway probe that deliberately writes into the plugin root: pytest exits 1 with the actionable message and the tree is restored. Full suite then runs clean.

surface_verification.runner: uv run --directory plugins/shipwright-security --extra dev pytest tests/ -v
